$comment: Names a login, a handle, a file name or a link writes without spaces, as a person erasure must read them in every engine: JavaScript and Postgres (services/memory/person-name-characters.ts: asciiSpelling, joinedNames, concatenatedNames, markWordSteps) and the graph's Cypher (memory-service/app/graphiti_client.py: _ascii_spelling, _joined_parts_all, _concatenated_forms, _marked).
people: the people erased. cases: text filed under a record named `name` ('Pricing' when absent), and whether erasing every person removes it.

Read by services/memory/erasure-rule-agreement.realdb.test.ts (the erasure and its suppression digests) and memory-service/tests/test_person_erasure_integration.py (the graph). Every engine must decide each case as `expected`. A case marked over-erasure erases a bystander, accepted as missing the person is worse.
